ui_wording.scores_note: Scores are the model's softmax output over four mutually exclusive classes. They are not independent disease probabilities and not a diagnosis.
ui_wording.heatmap_note: Colour shows which class a map explains; opacity shows attribution strength. Maps show regions that influenced the model, not lesion outlines.
ui_wording.region_note: Approximate facial region of strongest model attribution.
ui_wording.review_note: AI output is a screening aid pending review. It is not ground truth.

ground_truth_policy: Captured images start as Pending Review. They are never added to training data automatically.
